archetypes.name: dispatch-parity
archetypes.rationale: The Python dispatcher replaces several shell control-flow paths and must preserve Step 2 envelopes and safety gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/implement_dispatch.py against the retired Step 2 shell behavior. Focus on STATUS/AUTH envelope legality, malformed-manifest recovery, resume counters, branch/protected-path/submodule gates, and dispatcher-owned commits. Check that tests pin the highest-risk transitions rather than only happy paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-grants
archetypes.rationale: The Codex and Cursor implementer launchers deliberately run with write authority and changed sandbox grants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new agent launch-codex-implement and launch-cursor-implement paths in python/agents.py. Focus on Codex add-dir scoping, symlink parent rejection, temporary auth/config handling, Cursor auth/env behavior, and whether sidecar/transcript/manifest paths can widen write access or leak secrets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: reference-sweep
archetypes.rationale: This change deletes many public shell entrypoints and depends on docs, rules, and lint allowlists pointing to the new Python verbs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the deleted-script reference sweep across SKILL.md, docs, rules, agent-lint, migrated-scripts.tsv, and test harnesses. Look for stale shell paths, command examples that omit python3 where required, inaccurate Makefile target descriptions, or docs that overstate the new pytest coverage. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
